suggestDisplayDuration.name: suggestDisplayDuration
suggestDisplayDuration.description:
How long the suggestion UI stays visible if the player does not accept (seconds).
After this, it will be suggested again later.

baseWeight.description: Base weight for each powerup in the pool.

acceptWeightBonus.description: Extra weight added to the accepted powerup (bias towards what player chose).

maxWeight.description: Optional clamp for weights (keeps numbers bounded).

galaxyTexAsset.name: galaxyTexAsset
galaxyTexAsset.description:
Tileable galaxy texture. Recommended packing:
- RGB = nebula
- A   = stars mask (or noise)

originEntity.name: originEntity
originEntity.description:
Origin used to stabilize world mapping and “attach” the effect to the animal.
Usually set this to the animal root entity.

marbleTexAsset.name: marbleTexAsset
marbleTexAsset.description:
Tileable marble / noise texture.
- Best: single-channel (R) marble/noise, but any RGB works (we use .r).
